about.title: Hello! I'm Arthur Oliveira Sales, a Software Developer.
about.paragraphy1: I am a high school student and an aspiring software developer passionate about turning ideas into functional and intuitive interfaces. I am currently studying HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git while building projects that strengthen my programming logic and problem-solving skills.
about.paragraphy2: As a self-taught and curious learner, I enjoy understanding how technologies work behind the scenes and continuously improving with every project. My goal is to earn an internship, grow as a software developer, and build a career focused on remote work.
